title: A Survey on Medical Large Language Models: Technology, Application, Trustworthiness, and Future Directions

bias_targets.methodology: The paper surveys the field's use of disparity metrics and counterfactual evaluation (constructing hypothetical scenarios) to quantify and reveal racial biases captured from clinical practice and research corpora.

The paper surveys existing literature on gender bias in medical LLMs, highlighting the use of disparity metrics and counterfactual evaluation to detect unfair treatment and biases amplified from training data.
The paper notes that disability bias is evaluated in the medical domain using disparity metrics and counterfactual evaluation to uncover skewed outputs resulting from biased medical training data.
The paper reviews the use of specific medical benchmarks, such as BiasMedQA, which utilize disparity metrics to quantify specific levels of cognitive bias in LLMs performing medical tasks.
